load_nllb_model: load an NLLB multilingual model from a Fairseq checkpoint for ALTI attribution analysis
load_bilingual_model: load a bilingual Fairseq translation model from a checkpoint for ALTI hub inference
ALTIMetricsConfig: create an ALTIMetricsConfig dataclass to configure model paths, language codes, and output file locations
compute_nllb_alti: compute ALTI attribution scores for source-target sentence pairs using an NLLB model and save metrics
NLLB200_LANGS: reference the NLLB200 language codes string containing all 200 supported language-script pairs
